MOGUL MOUNTAIN VENTURES CORPORATION
(formerly Panorama Capital Corp.)
Vancouver, British Columbia – TheNewswire - September 4, 2026 – Mogul Mountain Ventures Corporation

(“Mogul” or the “Company”) is pleased to announce that it has entered into agreements with Kin Communications Inc. (“Kin”) and Market One Media Group Inc. (“Market One”) to support the Company’s investor relations, communications and investor marketing activities, and has retained Integral Wealth Securities Limited (“Integral”) to provide market-making services.

The engagements are intended to support Mogul’s capital markets and investor communications strategy following the commencement of trading of its common shares on the TSX Venture Exchange (“TSXV”) on September 1, 2026. The agreements are subject to acceptance by the TSXV.
Kin Communications

Mogul has retained Kin to provide investor relations and corporate communications services, including investor and broker outreach, shareholder communications, development of investor materials and support for the communication of the Company’s corporate and exploration activities.

Under the agreement, Kin will receive a monthly fee of C$15,000, plus applicable taxes. The agreement has an initial term of 12 months and thereafter continues on a month-to-month basis unless terminated in accordance with its terms.

Subject to TSXV acceptance and the Company’s equity incentive plan, Kin will also be granted 300,000 stock options exercisable at C$0.35 per common share for a period of five years. The options will vest over 12 months, with 25% vesting every three months commencing three months following the date of grant.

Kin is a Vancouver-based investor relations firm providing investor communications, corporate communications and capital markets advisory services to publicly traded companies.  Kin is owned by President & CEO Arlen Hansen and has no direct relationship with the Company, other than as disclosed in this news release.
Market One Media Group
Mogul has engaged Market One to undertake a 12-month investor marketing and media program designed to increase awareness of the Company among Canadian investors.

The program will include investor-focused video and editorial content, including a Market One Minute interview, two investor update video articles, a corporate video, digital advertising, social media distribution and other investor marketing initiatives. Market One will receive an upfront cash fee of C$59,500 plus applicable taxes for the 12-month program. There are no performance factors contained in the agreement and Market One will not receive any securities of the Company as compensation.

Market One is a Vancouver-based media and marketing company providing digital media, video production, investor-focused content and distribution services to publicly traded companies.  Market One and the Company are arm's length parties, and neither Market One nor any of its principals had an interest, directly or indirectly, in any securities of the Company.
Integral Wealth Securities Limited

Mogul has retained Integral to provide market-making services with the objectives of maintaining a reasonable market and improving the liquidity of the Company’s common shares in accordance with TSXV policies.

In consideration for the services provided, Mogul will pay Integral a monthly cash fee of C$6,000 plus applicable taxes. There are no performance factors contained in the agreement and Integral will not receive securities of the Company as compensation. However, Integral and its clients may have or may acquire a direct interest in securities of the Company.

Mogul and Integral are unrelated and unaffiliated entities. Integral is a member of the Canadian Investment Regulatory Organization (“CIRO”) and can access Canadian stock exchanges and alternative trading systems. The capital and securities required for any trades undertaken by Integral as principal will be provided by Integral, and no third party will be providing funds or securities for the market making activities.

The agreement has a minimum term of three months. Following the initial term, the engagement will continue on a month-to-month basis and may be terminated by either party on 30 days’ prior written notice.

Integral Wealth Securities Limited is a national, independent investment dealer providing investment banking, capital markets and wealth management services. Founded in 2003, the firm has established capabilities in market making, investment banking and private debt and equity.
About Mogul

Mogul is a gold-silver exploration company focused on advancing high-potential precious metals assets in Nevada’s prolific Walker Lane Trend. Mogul’s flagship asset, the 100%-owned, 5,000+ acre Rays-West Dome Project, is located approximately 12 km north of the historic Tonopah mining district and consolidates multiple brownfield targets featuring historic mine workings, high-grade surface mineralization and district-scale structural features.

Rays-West Dome hosts two complementary mineral systems: a structurally controlled orogenic gold-silver system at the Rays target and an epithermal-style gold–silver system within Tertiary volcanic rocks at West Dome. Supported by extensive geophysical and geochemical datasets, visible gold at surface and multiple drill-ready targets, Mogul is well positioned for discovery.
Qualified Person

David Flint, P.Geo., is a Qualified Person, as defined by National Instrument 43-101 – Standards of Disclosure for Mineral Projects, for the Company and is a Technical Advisor to Mogul. He has reviewed and approved the technical information in this news release.
